sections.overview: Scinax funereus is a snouted treefrog of the upper Amazon Basin, recorded in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.
sections.identification: Its dark markings and yellow-marked flanks help distinguish it; the common name Mossy Agile Frog is used in Ecuadorian references.
sections.habitat: Calling males have been recorded in a shallow swamp with shrubs and at the edge of a forest pool in the Ecuadorian Amazon.
sections.diet: The species-specific accounts consulted do not establish its adult diet.
sections.behavior: Males call after dark from leaves or shrubs; they were rarely detected at two Ecuadorian study sites.
sections.reproduction: The available field study describes calling males but does not document egg-laying or parental care, so those details remain uncertain.
sections.ecology: Amphibian Species of the World places it in the Scinax funereus group; its described call is a single pulsed note.
sections.conservation: The IUCN assessment lists it as Least Concern.
